summary: Recursively deserializes one collision tree node from a file stream. Reads a header, then a signed node-type byte stored at offset 8: internal types 0/1 read a subtype byte at offset 10 and recurse into two children (offset 12 = child-slot arena pointer v2[12] + 16*v2[10]); negative leaf types (-1 = single, -2 = pair) allocate a 92-byte vertex output region (offset 12 = v2[9] + 92*v2[7]) and read v7 indexed vertices via IndexedVertexLookupFromStream. Called by HTreeTerrainFileFormatLoader while loading a terrain file.

operations.description: First file read: FileWriteWithBackendDispatch(this, 4) must return exactly 4, otherwise fail with -1.
Second file read: FileWriteWithBackendDispatch(this + 4, 4) must return 4, otherwise fail with -1.
Third file read: read a single type byte into the low byte of the a2 argument; must return 1, otherwise fail with -1.
Store the signed type byte as a word at field offset 8 (node type).
Reject node type <= -3 as invalid; return -1.
Reject node type >= 2 as invalid; return -1.
Choose vertex count v7: default 2; -1 (single leaf) sets v7 = 1; -2 (pair leaf) keeps v7 = 2; any other negative value uses v7 = (int)a2.
Leaf storage: compute vertex output pointer at offset 12 as v2[9] + 92 * v2[7], and advance the arena cursor v2[7] by v7.
Read v7 indexed vertices: repeatedly call IndexedVertexLookupFromStream on advancing 92-byte slots; when all are read return 0, and if a lookup reports failure return -1.
Internal node: read one subtype byte via FileWriteWithBackendDispatch into a local; failure returns -1.
Store the subtype byte at field offset 10.
Internal storage: set offset 12 to v2[12] + 16 * v2[10] (child-slot arena) and advance v2[10] by 2.
Recurse to deserialize the first child; a nonzero result fails the node.
Recurse to deserialize the second child; a nonzero result fails the node, otherwise the node is a success.
Failure paths return -1; leaf success returns 0; internal success returns 0.

unresolved: The a2 arena cursor block layout (indices 7, 9, 10, 12) and the exact meaning of the offset-8 type byte are not defined by this packet; they are imposed by the terrain-file format owned by the caller.
The relationship between the 92-byte leaf stride and the 16-byte internal child stride is presumed from the offsets in the raw source and is unconfirmed by independent evidence.
Vertex-count path (int)a2 for negative types other than -1/-2 is decompiler-derived and its real format meaning is unknown.
